title: Phong
overview: Change the Phong parameters live and observe how diffuse brightness, specular intensity, and highlight size change.
explanation: Kd scales the diffuse component, Ks scales the specular component, and n controls the concentration of the highlight.

title: Transformations
overview: Edit the translation, rotation, and scale matrices to see their combined effect on the model.
explanation: Matrix multiplication is order-dependent. The point matrix is built as T · R · S, so scale is applied first, then rotation, then translation.
